title.zh: 卷338 列傳一百二十五 塞楞额 周学健 鄂昌 鄂乐舜 彭家屏 李因培 常安 福崧
title.en: Volume 338 Biographies 125: Sai Leng E, Zhou Xuejian, E Chang, E Leshun, Peng Jiaping, Li Yinpei, Chang An, Fu Song
title.raw: 卷338 列傳一百二十五 塞楞额 周学健 鄂昌 鄂乐舜 彭家屏 李因培 常安 福崧

sentences.zh: 列傳一百二十五

translations.literal: Biographies 125
translations.idiomatic: Biography 125

sentences.zh: 塞楞額週學健鄂昌鄂樂舜彭家屏李因培常安福崧

translations.literal: Sai Leng'e, Zhou Xuejian, E Chang, E Leshun, Peng Jiaping, Li Yinpei, Chang An, Fu Song
translations.idiomatic: Sai Leng'e, Zhou Xuejian, E Chang, E Leshun, Peng Jiaping, Li Yinpei, Chang An, and Fu Song

sentences.zh: 塞楞額，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Sai Leng'e, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a bondsman of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Leng'e, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十八年進士，授內閣中書，擢翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a Secretariat drafter, and was promoted to Hanlin Academy lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the forty-eighth year of Kangxi (1709), was appointed a Secretariat drafter, and was promoted to lecturer in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 四遷至侍郎，歷刑、兵、禮諸部。

translations.literal: After four promotions he reached vice minister, serving in succession in the Ministries of Punishments, War, and Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After four promotions he rose to vice minister, serving in turn in the Ministries of Punishments, War, and Rites.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，出署山東巡撫，入為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng he went out to serve as acting Shandong governor, then entered the capital as vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng (1724) he was sent out as acting governor of Shandong, then recalled to the capital as vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 如廣東按將軍李杕縱部兵毀米廠、閧巡撫署，事竟，仍署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: When sent to Guangdong on investigation, [he dealt with] General Li Di's allowing his troops to destroy granaries and storm the governor's yamen; when the matter was concluded he again served as acting Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: While investigating in Guangdong, he handled the case of General Li Di, whose troops had destroyed granaries and stormed the governor's yamen; when the affair was settled he resumed his post as acting governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 疏請以東平州安山湖官地分畀窮民栽柳捕魚為業，上許之，並令發耗羨備用銀為建屋制船；

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that official land at Anshan Lake in Dongping Prefecture be divided among the poor for planting willows and fishing as their livelihood; the emperor approved, and also ordered that surplus silver from the fee allowance reserve be issued for building houses and making boats;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that official land at Anshan Lake in Dongping Prefecture be allotted to the poor for planting willows and fishing; the emperor approved and ordered surplus silver from the fee allowance reserve released to build houses and boats;

sentences.zh: 又疏請浚柳長河，開引河二，疏積水。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to dredge the Liu-Chang River, open two diversion channels, and drain accumulated water.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized to dredge the Liu-Chang River, open two diversion channels, and drain the standing water.

sentences.zh: 復入為工部侍郎，緣事奪官。

translations.literal: He again entered the capital as vice minister of Works, but lost his office on account of an affair.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital as vice minister of Works but was stripped of his rank over an unrelated matter.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，賜副都統銜，如索倫、巴爾虎練兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was granted the rank of vice commander-in-chief and sent to drill troops among the Solon and Barhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736) he was granted the rank of vice commander-in-chief and sent to drill troops among the Solon and Barhu.

sentences.zh: 尋授鑲藍旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: Shortly after he was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Bordered Blue Banner Chinese Martial.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Bordered Blue Banner Chinese Martial.

sentences.zh: 出為陝西巡撫，移江西。

translations.literal: He went out as Shaanxi governor and was transferred to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Shaanxi and later transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 疏請築豐城石堤，封廣信府銅塘山，均許之。

translations.literal: He memorialized to build a stone dike at Fengcheng and seal off Tongtang Mountain in Guangxin Prefecture; both were approved.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to build a stone dike at Fengcheng and to seal off Tongtang Mountain in Guangxin Prefecture; both requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 再移山東。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1746) he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十三年，孝賢皇后崩，故事，遇國卹，諸臣當於百日後薙發。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Empress Xiaoxian died; by precedent, when there was national mourning, all officials were to shave their heads only after the hundred-day period.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1748) Empress Xiaoxian died; by precedent, during national mourning officials were to shave their heads only after the hundred-day mourning period had passed.

sentences.zh: 錦州知府金文醇違制被劾，逮下刑部，擬斬候。

translations.literal: Jin Wenchun, prefect of Jinzhou, was impeached for violating the regulations; he was arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed deferred execution.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Wenchun, prefect of Jinzhou, was impeached for shaving his head in violation of the regulations; he was arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed execution with reprieve.

sentences.zh: 上以為不當，責尚書盛安沽譽，予重譴。

translations.literal: The emperor considered this inappropriate, reproached Minister Sheng An for currying favor, and imposed severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deemed the sentence too harsh, rebuked Minister Sheng An for currying favor, and imposed severe punishment on him.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫安寧​​舉江南河南總督週學健薙發如文醇，上並命逮治。

translations.literal: Jiangsu governor An Ning reported that Jiangnan-Henan governor-general Zhou Xuejian had shaved his head like Wenchun; the emperor ordered both to be arrested and tried.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu governor An Ning reported that Jiangnan-Henan governor-general Zhou Xuejian had shaved his head early, as Wenchun had; the emperor ordered both men arrested and tried.

sentences.zh: 因詔諸直省察屬吏中有違制薙發者，不必治其罪，但令以名聞。

translations.literal: Thereupon he decreed that all provinces should investigate among subordinate officials for those who had violated the regulations by shaving their heads; they need not be punished, but only their names reported.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then decreed that every province should investigate which subordinates had shaved their heads in violation of the regulations; they were not to be punished, but only their names reported.

sentences.zh: 是時塞楞額亦薙發，湖北巡撫彭樹葵、湖南巡撫楊錫紱及諸屬吏皆從之。

translations.literal: At this time Sai Leng'e had also shaved his head; Hubei governor Peng Shukui, Hunan governor Yang Xizhen, and all subordinate officials followed suit.
translations.idiomatic: By then Sai Leng'e had also shaved his head; Hubei governor Peng Shukui, Hunan governor Yang Xizhen, and all their subordinates had done the same.

sentences.zh: 得詔，塞楞額具疏自陳，上命還京師待罪。

translations.literal: Upon receiving the decree, Sai Leng'e submitted a memorial confessing himself; the emperor ordered him to return to the capital to await judgment.
translations.idiomatic: When the decree arrived, Sai Leng'e submitted a memorial confessing his offense; the emperor ordered him back to the capital to await judgment.

sentences.zh: 諭謂：「文醇已擬斬決，豈知督撫中有周學健，則無怪於文醇；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Wenchun had already been proposed for execution—who would have known that among the governors-general and governors there was Zhou Xuejian? Then Wenchun is no wonder;
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Wenchun had already been proposed for execution—who would have guessed that among the governors-general and governors was Zhou Xuejian? Then Wenchun is hardly surprising;

sentences.zh: 豈知滿洲大臣中有塞楞額，又無怪於學健。」

translations.literal: who would have known that among the Manchu grand ministers there was Sai Leng'e? Then Xuejian is no wonder either."
translations.idiomatic: who would have guessed that among the Manchu grand ministers was Sai Leng'e? Then Xuejian is hardly surprising either."

sentences.zh: 因釋文醇，寬學健，皆發直隸，以修城自贖。

translations.literal: Therefore Wenchun was released, Xuejian was shown leniency; both were sent to Zhili to redeem themselves by repairing the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Wenchun was therefore released and Xuejian treated leniently; both were sent to Zhili to redeem themselves by working on the city walls.

sentences.zh: 樹葵、錫紱誤從塞楞額，錫紱並勸塞楞額檢舉，皆貸罪；

translations.literal: Shukui and Xizhen had mistakenly followed Sai Leng'e; Xizhen had also urged Sai Leng'e to report the others—all were pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: Shukui and Xizhen had mistakenly followed Sai Leng'e's example; Xizhen had even urged Sai Leng'e to report the others—all were pardoned;

sentences.zh: 令樹葵分任修城，示薄罰。

translations.literal: Peng Shukui was ordered to share in the wall-repair duty as a token punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Shukui was ordered to take a share of the wall-repair work as a token punishment.

sentences.zh: 塞楞額至刑部，論斬決。

translations.literal: Sai Leng'e was sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed execution.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Leng'e was sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed immediate execution.

sentences.zh: 上謂：「祖宗定制，君臣大義，而違蔑至此，萬無可恕！

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The ancestral regulations and the great principle between sovereign and minister—and to defy them to this extent is utterly unforgivable!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The regulations left by our ancestors embody the great bond between sovereign and minister—to defy them so brazenly is utterly unforgivable!

sentences.zh: 以尚為舊臣，令宣諭賜自盡。」

translations.literal: Yet as he is still an old servant, let an edict be proclaimed granting him death by his own hand."
translations.idiomatic: Yet because he is still an old servant, let an edict be proclaimed granting him permission to take his own life."

sentences.zh: 學健，江西新健人。

translations.literal: Xuejian was a native of Xinjian, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Xuejian was a native of Xinjian in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年進士，改庶吉士，散館授編修。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin as a probationer, and after leaving the academy was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Yongzheng (1723), entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and after completing his term was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 五遷至戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: After five promotions he reached vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: After five promotions he rose to vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 命如山東按事，兩詣上下江會督撫治災賑、水利，出署福建巡撫、浙閩總督。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Shandong to investigate affairs, twice went to the upper and lower Yangzi to join governors-general in managing disaster relief and waterworks, and served as acting Fujian governor and Zhe-Fujian governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Shandong on investigative duty, twice traveled to the upper and lower Yangzi to join the governors-general in disaster relief and water control, and served as acting governor of Fujian and governor-general of Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 加太子少保，授江南河道總督，坐違制薙發，奪官，命江西巡撫開泰籍其家。

translations.literal: He was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and appointed Jiangnan river conservancy governor-general; for violating the regulations by shaving his head he was stripped of office, and Jiangxi governor Kaitai was ordered to inventory his household.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and appointed governor-general of Jiangnan river conservancy; for shaving his head in violation of the mourning regulations he was dismissed, and Jiangxi governor Kaitai was ordered to inventory his estate.

sentences.zh: 開泰發其往來私書，中有丁憂兗沂曹道吳同仁行賕學健，乞舉以自代。

translations.literal: Kaitai discovered his private correspondence, including a letter from Wu Tongren of the Yan-Yi-Cao Circuit in mourning, who had bribed Xuejian and begged to be recommended as his successor.
translations.idiomatic: Kaitai uncovered his private correspondence, including a letter from Wu Tongren of the Yan-Yi-Cao Circuit, then in mourning, who had bribed Xuejian and asked to be recommended as his successor.

sentences.zh: 上為罷陳舉自代例，詔曰：「朕令大臣舉可以自代之人，凡以拔茅茹、顯俊乂之意也。

translations.literal: The emperor therefore abolished the precedent of recommending one's own successor and issued an edict: "When I order grand ministers to recommend persons who could replace them, it is entirely in the spirit of drawing up the good by the root and displaying the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore abolished the practice of recommending one's own successor and issued an edict: "When I ask grand ministers to name those who could replace them, it is solely to draw up talent by the root and bring forth the worthy.

sentences.zh: 今同仁囑學健許以兩千，朕不解焉。

translations.literal: Now Tongren had Xuejian promise him two thousand—this I do not understand.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tongren had Xuejian promise him two thousand taels—I cannot fathom this.

sentences.zh: 問之錢陳群，始知為賕。

translations.literal: When he asked Qian Chenqun, he learned it was a bribe.
translations.idiomatic: When he asked Qian Chenqun, he learned that it was a bribe.

sentences.zh: 夫考績黜陟，何可為苞苴之門，豈朕若渴之誠尚未喻於二三大臣耶？

translations.literal: How can assessment of merit and promotion and demotion become a door for gift-giving? Has my earnest thirst for talent still not been understood by you great ministers?
translations.idiomatic: How can merit review and appointments become a channel for bribery? Has my earnest search for talent still not reached you great ministers?

sentences.zh: 朕甚恧焉！

translations.literal: I am deeply ashamed!
translations.idiomatic: I am deeply ashamed of this!

sentences.zh: 其罷之。」

translations.literal: Let it be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Let this practice be abolished."

sentences.zh: 別詔又謂：「學健卞急剛愎，不料其不勵名檢竟至於此！」

translations.literal: A separate edict also said: "Xuejian is impetuous and obstinate—I never expected that his failure to uphold moral discipline would reach this point!"
translations.idiomatic: A separate edict also declared: "Xuejian is impetuous and obstinate—I never imagined his neglect of moral discipline would go this far!"

sentences.zh: 下兩江總督策楞覆勘，具得學健營私受贓、縱戚屬奴僕骫法狀，刑部引塞楞額及前步軍統領鄂善例論斬決。

translations.literal: The Liangjiang governor-general Celeng was ordered to reinvestigate and fully established Xuejian's embezzlement, acceptance of bribes, and indulgence of kinsmen and servants in bending the law; the Ministry of Punishments cited the precedents of Sai Leng'e and the former metropolitan garrison commander E Shan and proposed execution.
translations.idiomatic: The Liangjiang governor-general Celeng was ordered to reinvestigate and fully documented Xuejian's embezzlement, bribe-taking, and indulgence of relatives and servants in breaking the law; the Ministry of Punishments cited the precedents of Sai Leng'e and the former metropolitan garrison commander E Shan and proposed execution.

sentences.zh: 上謂學健違制罪已貰，婪贓鬻破薦舉事視鄂善尤重，賜自盡。

translations.literal: The emperor said that Xuejian's offense of violating the regulations had already been pardoned, but his greed for bribes and selling out recommendations was even graver than E Shan's and merited death by his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that Xuejian's violation of the mourning regulations had already been pardoned, but his greed for bribes and trafficking in recommendations was even graver than E Shan's case, and he was granted permission to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 鄂昌，西林覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，大學士鄂爾泰從子也。

translations.literal: E Chang, of the Xilin Gioro clan, was a bondsman of the Bordered Blue Banner and a nephew of Grand Secretary Ortai.
translations.idiomatic: E Chang, of the Xilin Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner and a nephew of Grand Secretary Ortai.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，以舉人授戶部主事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongzheng, as a provincial graduate he was appointed a Revenue Department clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yongzheng (1728), as a provincial graduate he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 七年，超擢陝西寧夏道。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted out of turn to Shaanxi Ningxia circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1729) he was promoted out of turn to intendant of the Ningxia circuit in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷甘肅布政使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Gansu provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1732) he was transferred to provincial administration commissioner of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署陝西巡撫，旋授四川巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as acting Shaanxi governor, then was appointed Sichuan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1733) he served as acting governor of Shaanxi, then was appointed governor of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 酉陽州土司冉元齡老病，子廣烜襲，土民苦其貪暴，鄂昌奏請改土歸流。

translations.literal: Ran Yuanling, native chieftain of Youyang Prefecture, was old and ill; his son Guangxuan succeeded him, and the native people suffered under his greed and cruelty; E Chang memorialized to replace native rule with direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: Ran Yuanling, native chieftain of Youyang Prefecture, was aged and ill; his son Guangxuan succeeded him, and the local people suffered under his greed and cruelty; E Chang memorialized to abolish native rule and bring the territory under regular administration.

sentences.zh: 十三年，總督黃廷桂劾鄂昌貪縱，命奪職，以楊馝代之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Governor-General Huang Tinggui impeached E Chang for greed and indulgence; he was ordered stripped of office and replaced by Yang Fei.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1735) Governor-General Huang Tinggui impeached E Chang for greed and lax discipline; he was stripped of office and replaced by Yang Fei.

sentences.zh: 遣刑部侍郎申珠渾會馝按治，得鄂昌枷斃罪人及受屬吏銀瓶諸狀，命逮下刑部，論杖徒，遇赦免。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Shen Zhuhun of the Ministry of Punishments was sent to join Fei in investigating; they established E Chang's cudgeling prisoners to death and receiving silver vessels from subordinates; he was ordered arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed beating and penal servitude; he was pardoned by amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Shen Zhuhun of the Ministry of Punishments was dispatched to join Fei in the investigation; they established that E Chang had beaten prisoners to death in the cangue and accepted silver vessels from subordinates; he was arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed beating and penal servitude; he was spared by a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，令在批本處行走。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was ordered to serve in the document-drafting office.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736) he was assigned to serve in the document-drafting office.

sentences.zh: 二年，授直隸口北道，遷甘肅按察使。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Zhili Koubei circuit intendant and transferred to Gansu provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1737) he was appointed intendant of the Koubei circuit in Zhili and then transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 山西民梁玥等在高台遇盜死，知縣伍升堂捕良民鍛煉論罪，鄂昌雪其冤，得真盜置之法。

translations.literal: Liang Yue and others of Shanxi were killed by bandits at Gaotai; Magistrate Wu Shengtang arrested innocent commoners and framed them for conviction; E Chang cleared their injustice, found the real bandits, and had them punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Yue and other Shanxi travelers were killed by bandits at Gaotai; Magistrate Wu Shengtang arrested innocent men and framed them for conviction; E Chang cleared their names, caught the real bandits, and had them punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 巡撫黃廷桂疏陳鄂昌平反狀，旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: Governor Huang Tinggui memorialized E Chang's merits in settling the case; an imperial rescript praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Huang Tinggui memorialized E Chang's success in resolving the case; the emperor responded with praise.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷廣西布政使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Guangxi provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1744) he was transferred to provincial administration commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as acting Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1746) he served as acting governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 疏請以鄂爾泰祀廣西名宦，上責其私，不許。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Ortai be enshrined among Guangxi's famous officials; the emperor reproached him for partiality and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Ortai be entered in Guangxi's shrine of famous officials; the emperor rebuked him for favoritism and refused.

sentences.zh: 十二年，疏自陳舉布政使李錫泰自代，上复責其朋比。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he memorialized recommending provincial administration commissioner Li Xitai as his successor; the emperor again reproached him for factional collusion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1747) he memorialized recommending provincial administration commissioner Li Xitai as his successor; the emperor again rebuked him for cliquish favoritism.

sentences.zh: 因命督撫不得舉本省籓臬自代，著為例。

translations.literal: Thereupon governors-general and governors were ordered not to recommend their own province's provincial officials as successors, and this was established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered that governors-general and governors might not recommend officials of their own province as successors, and this was made a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 迭移江蘇、四川、甘肅諸省，署甘肅提督、陝甘總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred in succession to Jiangsu, Sichuan, and Gansu, and served as acting Gansu provincial military commander and Shaan-Gan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred in turn through Jiangsu, Sichuan, and Gansu, and served as acting provincial military commander of Gansu and governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 复移江西巡撫。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to serve as governor of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 時傳播尚書孫嘉淦疏稿有誣謗語，命諸行省究所從來。

translations.literal: At the time a memorial draft by Minister Sun Jiagan was circulating with slanderous language; the emperor ordered all provinces to trace its origin.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a draft memorial by Minister Sun Jiagan was circulating that contained slanderous passages; the emperor ordered every province to trace where it had come from.

sentences.zh: 鄂昌以坐廣饒九​​南道施廷翰子奕度逮下刑部，鞫無據，雪其枉，召鄂昌詣京師待命。

translations.literal: E Chang had arrested Yidu, son of Guangrao-Jiunan circuit intendant Shi Tinghan, and sent him to the Ministry of Punishments; interrogation found no basis, his wrongful conviction was cleared, and E Chang was summoned to the capital to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: E Chang had arrested Yidu, son of Guangrao-Jiunan circuit intendant Shi Tinghan, and sent him to the Ministry of Punishments; the interrogation found no evidence, the wrongful conviction was overturned, and E Chang was summoned to the capital to await further orders.

sentences.zh: 獄定，誅千總盧魯生。

translations.literal: When the case was concluded, company commander Lu Lusheng was executed.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was concluded, company commander Lu Lusheng was executed.

sentences.zh: 責鄂昌誤讞，下刑部，論杖徒，命貸罪，發往軍台效力。

translations.literal: E Chang was reproached for a mistaken verdict, sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed beating and penal servitude; he was pardoned and sent to serve at a military post.
translations.idiomatic: E Chang was rebuked for a mistaken verdict and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed beating and penal servitude; his punishment was remitted and he was sent to serve at a military post on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 十九年閏四月，命以甘肅貯官茶發北路軍備用，命鄂昌董其事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the nineteenth year he was ordered to issue the official tea stored in Gansu for northern-route military use, and E Chang was put in charge.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of the nineteenth year (1754) he was ordered to distribute the official tea stored in Gansu for the northern-route armies, with E Chang placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 旋授甘肅巡撫，理軍需。

translations.literal: Shortly after he was appointed Gansu governor to manage military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Gansu to manage military supplies.

sentences.zh: 內閣學士胡中藻著堅磨生集，文辭險怪，上指詩中語訕上，坐悖逆誅。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Hu Zhongzao wrote the Jianmo Sheng Collection with strange and perilous diction; the emperor pointed to lines in the poems that mocked him, and Hu was executed for treasonous rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Hu Zhongzao published the Jianmo Sheng Collection in a strange and menacing style; the emperor cited lines in the poems that mocked the throne, and Hu was executed for treason.

sentences.zh: 中藻故鄂爾泰門人，鄂昌與唱和。

translations.literal: Zhongzao had been a disciple of Ortai; E Chang exchanged verses with him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzao had been a disciple of Ortai, and E Chang had exchanged poems with him.

sentences.zh: 上命奪職，逮至京師下獄。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him stripped of office, arrested, and imprisoned in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him stripped of office, arrested, and imprisoned in the capital.

sentences.zh: 大學士九卿會鞫，籍其家，得所著塞上吟，語怨望；

translations.literal: Grand secretaries and the Nine Ministers jointly interrogated him; his household was inventoried and his Saishang Yin was found, with language of resentment;
translations.idiomatic: The grand secretaries and Nine Ministers jointly tried him; his household was searched and his Saishang Yin was found, full of resentful language;

sentences.zh: 又聞鄂容安從軍，輒云「奈何奈何」，上責以失滿洲踴躍行師舊俗。

translations.literal: it was also heard that when E Rong'an went on campaign he kept saying "What to do, what to do"; the emperor reproached him for abandoning the old Manchu custom of eager advance on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: it was also reported that when E Rong'an went on campaign he kept saying "What is to be done, what is to be done"; the emperor rebuked him for abandoning the old Manchu custom of eager advance on campaign.

sentences.zh: 又得與大學士史貽直書稿，知貽直為其子奕簪請託，上為罷貽直。

translations.literal: Correspondence with Grand Secretary Shi Yizhi was also found, showing that Yizhi had solicited favors for his son Yizan; the emperor dismissed Yizhi on this account.
translations.idiomatic: Correspondence with Grand Secretary Shi Yizhi was also found, revealing that Yizhi had solicited favors for his son Yizan; the emperor dismissed Yizhi on this account.

sentences.zh: 諭：「鄂昌負恩黨逆，罪當肆市。

translations.literal: An edict said: "E Chang has betrayed favor and joined rebellion; his crime merits public execution.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "E Chang has betrayed imperial favor and joined the rebels; his crime merits execution by dismemberment in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 但尚能知罪，又於貽直請託狀直承無諱，朕得以明正官常，從寬賜自盡。」

translations.literal: Yet he can still acknowledge his guilt, and in the matter of Yizhi's solicitation he confessed frankly without concealment, enabling me to clarify official norms; he is granted leniency and death by his own hand."
translations.idiomatic: Yet he still acknowledges his guilt, and in the matter of Yizhi's solicitation he confessed frankly without evasion, enabling me to clarify official norms; he is shown leniency and granted permission to take his own life."

sentences.zh: 中藻，江西新建人。

translations.literal: Zhongzao was a native of Xinjian, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zhongzao was a native of Xinjian in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Qianlong (1736).

sentences.zh: 上舉其詩有曰「又降一世」，曰「亦天之子」，曰「與一世爭在醜夷」，無慮數十事，語悖慢；

translations.literal: The emperor cited his poems, such as "descending yet another generation," "also a son of Heaven," and "contending with a generation lies in the ugly barbarian"—no fewer than several dozen instances of rebellious and disrespectful language;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor cited his poems, including lines such as "descending yet another generation," "also a son of Heaven," and "contending with a generation lies in the ugly barbarian"—dozens of instances in all of rebellious and disrespectful language;

sentences.zh: 又有「西林第一門」語，斥其攀援門戶，恬不知恥。

translations.literal: there was also the phrase "first gate of the Western Grove," rebuking his clinging to factional patronage without a shred of shame.
translations.idiomatic: there was also the line "first gate of the Western Grove," rebuking his clinging to factional patronage without the slightest shame.

sentences.zh: 因及鄂爾泰及張廷玉秉政，各有引援，朋分角立。

translations.literal: The edict went on to Ortai and Zhang Tingyu holding power, each with their own patronage networks, factions rivaling one another.
translations.idiomatic: The edict went on to Ortai and Zhang Tingyu holding power, each with his own network of patronage, factions standing opposed like horn and corner.

sentences.zh: 謂：「如鄂爾泰猶在，當治其植黨之罪。」

translations.literal: It said: "Had Ortai still been alive, he should have been punished for planting a faction."
translations.idiomatic: It declared: "Had Ortai still been alive, he should have been punished for building a faction."

sentences.zh: 命罷賢良祠祀。

translations.literal: He was ordered removed from the Shrine of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai was ordered removed from the Shrine of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 鄂樂舜亦鄂爾泰從子，初名鄂敏。

translations.literal: E Leshun was also a nephew of Ortai; his original name was E Min.
translations.idiomatic: E Leshun was also a nephew of Ortai; his original name was E Min.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin as a probationer, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the eighth year of Yongzheng (1730), entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 秋讞侍班，刑部侍郎王國棟放縱愆儀。

translations.literal: At the autumn assize he attended in waiting; Vice Minister Wang Guodong of the Ministry of Punishments was lax in observance of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: While attending the autumn assize, Vice Minister Wang Guodong of the Ministry of Punishments was lax in court decorum.

sentences.zh: 上命之退，鄂敏未引去。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him to withdraw, but E Min did not retire.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Wang to withdraw, but E Min did not leave his post.

sentences.zh: 因以責鄂敏，奪官。

translations.literal: E Min was therefore reproached and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: E Min was therefore rebuked and stripped of his rank.

sentences.zh: 逾年，复編修。

translations.literal: After a year he was restored as compiler.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was restored to his post as compiler.

sentences.zh: 出為江西瑞州知府，累遷湖北布政使。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Ruizhou in Jiangxi and was promoted in succession to Hubei provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Ruizhou in Jiangxi and rose in succession to provincial administration commissioner of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 命更名鄂樂舜。

translations.literal: He was ordered to change his name to E Leshun.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to change his name to E Leshun.

sentences.zh: 遷甘肅巡撫，疏請茶引備安西五衛積貯；

translations.literal: He was transferred to Gansu governor and memorialized that tea certificates be issued to build up stores in the five guards of Anxi;
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Gansu and memorialized that tea transport certificates be issued to build up stores in the five guards of Anxi;

sentences.zh: 移浙江，修海塘；

translations.literal: transferred to Zhejiang, he repaired the seawalls;
translations.idiomatic: transferred to Zhejiang, he repaired the seawalls;

sentences.zh: 皆議行。

translations.literal: all were approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: all proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 尋移安徽，又移山東。

translations.literal: Shortly after he was transferred to Anhui, then again to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to Anhui, then again to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 未行，浙江按察使富勒渾密劾鄂樂舜在浙江時，布政使同德為婪索鹽商銀八千，命侍郎劉綸、浙閩總督喀爾吉善按治。

translations.literal: Before he departed, Zhejiang provincial surveillance commissioner Fulehun secretly impeached E Leshun for when he was in Zhejiang: provincial administration commissioner Tongde had extorted eight thousand taels from salt merchants; Vice Minister Liu Lun and Zhe-Fujian Governor-General Ka'erjishan were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could leave, Zhejiang provincial surveillance commissioner Fulehun secretly impeached E Leshun, reporting that while in Zhejiang, provincial administration commissioner Tongde had extorted eight thousand taels from salt merchants; Vice Minister Liu Lun and Zhe-Fujian Governor-General Ka'erjishan were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 綸等言鄂樂舜實假公使銀。

translations.literal: Lun and the others reported that E Leshun had in fact used public office to extort silver.
translations.idiomatic: Lun and the others reported that E Leshun had in fact used his office to extort silver.

sentences.zh: 上又命兩江總督尹繼善會鞫，得婪索鹽商狀，如富勒渾言，但無與同德事，鄂樂舜論絞，富勒渾亦坐誣治罪。

translations.literal: The emperor also ordered Liangjiang Governor-General Yin Jishan to join in the interrogation; they established the extortion from salt merchants as Fulehun had said, but found no involvement with Tongde; E Leshun was proposed strangulation, and Fulehun was also punished for false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also ordered Liangjiang Governor-General Yin Jishan to join the trial; they established the extortion from salt merchants as Fulehun had alleged, but found no collusion with Tongde; E Leshun was proposed for strangulation, and Fulehun was also punished for a false accusation.

sentences.zh: 上以定擬失當，擢富勒渾布政使，逮鄂樂舜至京師，賜自盡。

translations.literal: The emperor considered the proposed sentence inappropriate, promoted Fulehun to provincial administration commissioner, had E Leshun arrested and brought to the capital, and granted him death by his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deemed the proposed sentence inappropriate, promoted Fulehun to provincial administration commissioner, had E Leshun arrested and brought to the capital, and granted him permission to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 時後鄂昌死未一年也。

translations.literal: This came less than a year after E Chang's death.
translations.idiomatic: This came less than a year after E Chang's death.

sentences.zh: 彭家屏，字樂君，河南夏邑人。

translations.literal: Peng Jiaping, style name Lejun, was a native of Xiayi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Jiaping, style name Lejun, was a native of Xiayi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十年進士，授刑部主事，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, and was promoted in succession to director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the sixtieth year of Kangxi (1721), was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, and rose in succession to director.

sentences.zh: 考選山西道御史，外授直隸清河道。

translations.literal: Selected by examination as Shanxi circuit censor, he was sent out as Zhili Qinghe circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Selected by examination as censor of the Shanxi circuit, he was sent out as intendant of the Qinghe circuit in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 三遷江西布政使。

translations.literal: After three promotions he became Jiangxi provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became provincial administration commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 移雲南，再移江蘇。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Yunnan, then again to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yunnan, then again to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 以病乞罷。

translations.literal: He requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He requested retirement on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年春，高宗南巡，家屏迎謁。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Gaozong made a southern tour; Jiaping went out to welcome and pay respects.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-second year of Qianlong (1757), the emperor made a southern tour; Jiaping went out to welcome him and pay his respects.

sentences.zh: 上諮歲事，家屏奏：「夏邑及鄰縣永城上年被水災獨重。」

translations.literal: The emperor inquired about the year's harvest; Jiaping reported: "Xiayi and the neighboring county Yongcheng suffered especially severe flooding last year."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor inquired about the year's harvest; Jiaping reported: "Xiayi and the neighboring county of Yongcheng suffered especially severe flooding last year."

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫圖爾炳阿朝行在，上以家屏語詰之，猶言水未為災，上命偕家屏往勘；

translations.literal: Henan Governor Tu'erbing'a attended at the traveling palace; the emperor confronted him with Jiaping's words, but he still said the water had not caused disaster; the emperor ordered him to go with Jiaping to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: Henan Governor Tu'erbing'a attended at the traveling palace; the emperor confronted him with Jiaping's report, but he still insisted the floods had not caused disaster; the emperor ordered him to go with Jiaping to investigate;

sentences.zh: 又以問河東河道總督張師載，師載奏如家屏言，上謂師載篤實，語當不誑，飭圖爾炳阿秉公勘奏​​，毋更回護。

translations.literal: he also asked Hedong river conservancy governor-general Zhang Shizai, who reported as Jiaping had said; the emperor said Zhang was solid and reliable and his words should not deceive, and ordered Tu'erbing'a to investigate impartially and report, without further cover-up.
translations.idiomatic: he also asked Hedong river conservancy governor-general Zhang Shizai, who reported as Jiaping had; the emperor said Zhang was solid and reliable and would not deceive him, and ordered Tu'erbing'a to investigate impartially and report back without further cover-up.

sentences.zh: 上幸徐州，見饑民困苦狀，念夏邑、永城壤相接，被災狀亦當同；

translations.literal: When the emperor visited Xuzhou and saw the distress of the famine victims, he reflected that Xiayi and Yongcheng shared contiguous territory and their disaster conditions should be the same;
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Xuzhou and saw the distress of the famine victims, he reflected that Xiayi and Yongcheng shared contiguous territory and must have suffered similarly;

sentences.zh: 密令步軍統領衙門員外郎觀音保微服往視。

translations.literal: he secretly ordered Guanyinbao, an extra-grade officer of the metropolitan garrison command, to go in disguise to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: he secretly ordered Guanyinbao, an extra-grade officer of the metropolitan garrison command, to go in disguise and inspect.

sentences.zh: 上北還，發徐州，夏邑民張欽遮道言縣吏諱災，上申命圖爾炳阿詳勘。

translations.literal: On the emperor's return north, departing from Xuzhou, Zhang Qin of Xiayi blocked the road to report that county officials were concealing the disaster; the emperor again ordered Tu'erbing'a to investigate thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor's return north from Xuzhou, Zhang Qin of Xiayi blocked the road to report that county officials were concealing the disaster; the emperor again ordered Tu'erbing'a to investigate thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 次鄒縣，夏邑民劉元德复訴縣吏施賑不實，上不懌，詰主使，元德舉諸生段昌緒，命侍衛成林監元德還夏邑按其事；

translations.literal: At Zou County, Liu Yuande of Xiayi again complained that county officials were distributing relief falsely; the emperor was displeased and demanded who was behind it; Yuande named the licentiate Duan Changxu; the emperor ordered guard Cheng Lin to escort Yuande back to Xiayi to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: At Zou County, Liu Yuande of Xiayi again complained that county officials were distributing relief dishonestly; the emperor was displeased and demanded who was behind it; Yuande named the licentiate Duan Changxu; the emperor ordered guard Cheng Lin to escort Yuande back to Xiayi to investigate;

sentences.zh: 而觀音保還奏夏邑、永城、虞城、商丘四縣災甚重，積水久，田不可耕；

translations.literal: meanwhile Guanyinbao returned and reported that Xiayi, Yongcheng, Yucheng, and Shangqiu four counties had suffered extremely severe disaster, with standing water for a long time and fields impossible to cultivate;
translations.idiomatic: meanwhile Guanyinbao returned and reported that the four counties of Xiayi, Yongcheng, Yucheng, and Shangqiu had suffered extremely severe disaster, with standing water for a long time and fields impossible to cultivate;

sentences.zh: 災民鬻子女，人不過錢二三百，觀音保收災民子二，以其券呈上。

translations.literal: disaster victims were selling their sons and daughters for no more than two or three hundred cash each; Guanyinbao took in two children of disaster victims and presented their sale contracts to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: disaster victims were selling their sons and daughters for no more than two or three hundred cash each; Guanyinbao took in two children of disaster victims and presented their sale contracts to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 上為動容，詔舉其事，謂：「為吾赤子，而使骨肉不相顧至此，事不忍言。」

translations.literal: The emperor was deeply moved, proclaimed the matter publicly, and said: "These are my own children, yet flesh and blood cannot care for one another to this point—the matter is unbearable to speak of."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply moved, proclaimed the matter publicly, and said: "These are my own children, yet families cannot care for one another to this point—the matter is unbearable to speak of."

sentences.zh: 因奪圖爾炳阿職，戍烏里雅蘇台，諸縣吏皆坐罪。

translations.literal: Tu'erbing'a was therefore stripped of office and exiled to Uliassutai; all the county officials were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Tu'erbing'a was therefore stripped of office and exiled to Uliassutai; all the county officials were punished.

sentences.zh: 成林至夏邑，與知縣孫默召昌緒不至，捕諸家，於臥室得傳鈔吳三桂檄，以聞上。

translations.literal: Cheng Lin arrived at Xiayi; he and Magistrate Sun Mo summoned Changxu but he did not come; they searched his house and in his bedroom found a circulated copy of Wu Sangui's proclamation, which they reported to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Lin arrived at Xiayi; he and Magistrate Sun Mo summoned Changxu but he did not appear; they searched his house and in his bedroom found a circulated copy of Wu Sangui's proclamation, which they reported to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 上遂怒，貸圖爾炳阿遣戍及諸縣吏罪，令直隸總督方觀承覆按。

translations.literal: The emperor then grew angry, remitted Tu'erbing'a's exile and the county officials' punishments, and ordered Zhili Governor-General Fang Guancheng to reinvestigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then grew angry, remitted Tu'erbing'a's exile and the county officials' punishments, and ordered Zhili Governor-General Fang Guancheng to reinvestigate.

sentences.zh: 召家屏詣京師，問其家有無三桂傳鈔檄及他禁書。

translations.literal: Jiaping was summoned to the capital and asked whether his household had circulated copies of Sangui's proclamation or other banned books.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping was summoned to the capital and asked whether his household possessed circulated copies of Sangui's proclamation or other banned books.

sentences.zh: 家屏言有明季野史數種，未嘗檢閱，上責其辭遁，命奪職下刑部，使侍衛三泰按驗。

translations.literal: Jiaping said there were several kinds of unofficial Ming histories, which he had never examined; the emperor reproached him for evasive words, ordered him stripped of office and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, and had guard Santai investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping said there were several kinds of unofficial Ming histories that he had never examined; the emperor rebuked him for evasive words, ordered him stripped of office and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, and had guard Santai investigate.

sentences.zh: 家屏子傳笏慮得罪，焚其書，命逮昌緒、傳笏下刑部，誅昌緒，家屏、傳笏亦坐斬，籍其家，分田予貧民。

translations.literal: Jiaping's son Chuanhu, fearing guilt, burned the books; Changxu and Chuanhu were ordered arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments; Changxu was executed, Jiaping and Chuanhu were also sentenced to execution, their household inventoried, and land distributed to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping's son Chuanhu, fearing prosecution, burned the books; Changxu and Chuanhu were arrested and sent to the Ministry of Punishments; Changxu was executed, Jiaping and Chuanhu were also sentenced to execution, their estate was inventoried, and land was distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 圖爾炳阿又以家屏族譜上，譜號大彭統記，御名皆直書不缺筆。

translations.literal: Tu'erbing'a also submitted Jiaping's clan genealogy, titled Comprehensive Record of the Great Peng, in which imperial names were written directly without omitting strokes.
translations.idiomatic: Tu'erbing'a also submitted Jiaping's clan genealogy, titled Comprehensive Record of the Great Peng, in which imperial taboo names were written in full without omitting strokes.

sentences.zh: 上益怒，責家屏狂悖無君，即獄中賜自盡。

translations.literal: The emperor grew still angrier, reproached Jiaping for insolent disloyalty to the sovereign, and granted him death by his own hand in prison.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor grew still angrier, rebuked Jiaping for insolent disloyalty to the sovereign, and granted him permission to take his own life in prison.

sentences.zh: 秋讞，刑部入傳笏情實，上以子為父隱，貸其死。

translations.literal: At the autumn assize the Ministry of Punishments entered Chuanhu as a confirmed case; the emperor held that a son concealing for his father merited pardon, and spared his life.
translations.idiomatic: At the autumn assize the Ministry of Punishments entered Chuanhu as a confirmed case; the emperor held that a son who concealed evidence for his father deserved mercy, and spared his life.

sentences.zh: 上既譴家屏等，召圖爾炳阿還京師，逮默下刑部，命觀音保以通判知夏邑。

translations.literal: After punishing Jiaping and the others, the emperor summoned Tu'erbing'a back to the capital, arrested Mo and sent him to the Ministry of Punishments, and appointed Guanyinbao subprefect of Xiayi.
translations.idiomatic: After punishing Jiaping and the others, the emperor summoned Tu'erbing'a back to the capital, arrested Mo and sent him to the Ministry of Punishments, and appointed Guanyinbao subprefect of Xiayi.

sentences.zh: 手詔戒敕，謂：「刁頑既除，良懦可憫。

translations.literal: In a personal edict of admonition he said: "Now that the crafty and obstinate have been removed, the good and weak deserve compassion.
translations.idiomatic: In a personal edict of admonition he said: "Now that the crafty and obstinate have been removed, the good and the weak deserve compassion.

sentences.zh: 當善為撫綏，毋俾災民失所也。」

translations.literal: You must govern with care and comfort, and not let disaster victims lose their homes."
translations.idiomatic: You must govern with care and comfort, and not let disaster victims lose their homes."

sentences.zh: 李因培，雲南晉寧人。

translations.literal: Li Yinpei was a native of Jinning in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yinpei was a native of Jinning in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年進士，改庶吉士，散館授編修。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Qianlong he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin as a probationer, and after leaving the academy was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of Qianlong (1745), entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationer, and after completing his term was appointed a compiler.

sentences.zh: 十三年，特擢翰林院侍講學士，督山東學政。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was specially promoted to Hanlin Academy reader-in-waiting and supervised Shandong education.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1748) he was specially promoted to reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy and appointed educational commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十四年，再擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was again promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1749) he was again promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 十八年，署刑部侍郎，兼順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he served as acting vice minister of Punishments and concurrently as Shuntian metropolitan magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1753) he served as acting vice minister of Punishments and concurrently as metropolitan magistrate of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 蝗起，因培劾通永道王楷等不力捕，皆奪職；

translations.literal: When locusts appeared, Yinpei impeached Wang Kai and others of the Tongyong circuit for ineffective capture; all were stripped of office;
translations.idiomatic: When locusts appeared, Yinpei impeached Wang Kai and others of the Tongyong circuit for failing to capture them effectively; all were stripped of office;

sentences.zh: 又劾涿州知州李鍾俾虧倉穀，論罪如律。

translations.literal: he also impeached Li Zhongbi, prefect of Zhuozhou, for deficit in granary grain, and he was sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: he also impeached Li Zhongbi, prefect of Zhuozhou, for a deficit in granary grain, and he was sentenced according to law.

sentences.zh: 衡水知縣劉士玉，因培鄉人也，以賄敗，為直隸總督方觀承論劾。

translations.literal: Liu Shiyu, magistrate of Hengshui, was a fellow townsman of Yinpei; he was ruined by bribery and was impeached by Zhili Governor-General Fang Guancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiyu, magistrate of Hengshui, was a fellow townsman of Yinpei; he was ruined by bribery and was impeached by Zhili Governor-General Fang Guancheng.

sentences.zh: 冀州知州誇喀謁因培，因培稱士玉冤，誇喀因為申布政、按察兩司。

translations.literal: Kuaka, prefect of Jizhou, called on Yinpei; Yinpei declared Shiyu was wronged, and Kuaka therefore appealed on his behalf to the provincial administration and surveillance commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Kuaka, prefect of Jizhou, called on Yinpei; Yinpei declared that Shiyu had been wronged, and Kuaka therefore appealed on his behalf to the provincial administration and surveillance commissioners.

sentences.zh: 十九年，直隸布政使玉麟以其事聞，因培坐奪職。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Zhili provincial administration commissioner Yulin reported the matter, and Yinpei was stripped of office on this account.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1754) Zhili provincial administration commissioner Yulin reported the matter, and Yinpei was stripped of office on this account.

sentences.zh: 甫三月，起光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: After only three months he was reappointed director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: After only three months he was reappointed director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 复督山東學政。

translations.literal: He again supervised Shandong education.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as educational commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，移江蘇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1756) he was transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1759) he was transferred to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 學政任滿，移浙江。

translations.literal: When his term as educational commissioner ended, he was transferred to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: When his term as educational commissioner ended, he was transferred to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，任又滿，复移江蘇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, when his term again ended, he was again transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year (1762), when his term again ended, he was transferred again to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 上南巡，賦詩以賜。

translations.literal: On the emperor's southern tour he was presented with an imperial poem.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor's southern tour he was presented with an imperial poem.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，授禮部侍郎，尋改倉場侍郎，皆留督學。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed vice minister of Rites, then changed to vice minister of the granary depots, retaining supervision of education in both posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year (1763) he was appointed vice minister of Rites, then transferred to vice minister of the granary depots, retaining his educational duties in both posts.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，授湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year (1764) he was appointed governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 上諭湖廣總督吳達善曰：「因培能治事，學問亦優，但未免恃才，好居人上。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Huguang Governor-General Wu Dashan: "Yinpei can manage affairs and his learning is also excellent, but he cannot help relying on his talent and liking to rank above others.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed Huguang Governor-General Wu Dashan: "Yinpei can manage affairs and his learning is excellent, but he cannot help relying on his talent and liking to rank above others.

sentences.zh: 今初任民事，汝當留意，治事有不當，善規之；

translations.literal: Now that he is beginning civil administration for the first time, you must pay attention; if his governance is improper, advise him well;
translations.idiomatic: Now that he is taking up civil administration for the first time, you must watch him closely; if his governance is improper, advise him firmly;

sentences.zh: 不聽，即以聞。

translations.literal: if he will not listen, report it at once.
translations.idiomatic: if he will not listen, report it to me at once.

sentences.zh: 朕久未擢用，亦欲折鍊其氣質。

translations.literal: I have long withheld promoting him, also wishing to temper his disposition.
translations.idiomatic: I have long withheld promoting him, also wishing to temper his disposition.

sentences.zh: 今似勝於前，但恐志滿易盈，負朕造就耳。」

translations.literal: He now seems better than before, but I fear that when ambition is full it easily overflows, betraying my efforts to cultivate him."
translations.idiomatic: He now seems better than before, but I fear that when ambition runs full it easily overflows, betraying my efforts to cultivate him."

sentences.zh: 旋移湖南。

translations.literal: He was shortly transferred to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was shortly transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，又移福建，將行，常德被水。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was again transferred to Fujian; just as he was about to depart, Changde was flooded.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year (1766) he was again transferred to Fujian; just as he was about to depart, Changde was flooded.

sentences.zh: 上令速予災民一月糧，詔未至，因培令秋後勘災如故事。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that disaster victims be given one month's grain at once; before the edict arrived, Yinpei ordered investigation after autumn according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that disaster victims be given one month's grain at once; before the edict arrived, Yinpei ordered the disaster surveyed after autumn according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 上責因培「以將受代，五日京兆，不恤民瘼」，下部議，當降調。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached Yinpei: "About to be replaced, within five days in the capital—yet indifferent to the people's suffering"; the matter was sent to the ministries for deliberation, proposing demotion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Yinpei: "About to be replaced, within five days of the capital—yet indifferent to the people's suffering"; the matter was sent to the ministries for deliberation, proposing demotion.

sentences.zh: 甫兩月，授四川按察使。

translations.literal: After only two months he was appointed Sichuan provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After only two months he was appointed provincial surveillance commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 因培在湖南日，常德知府錫爾達發武陵知縣馮其柘虧庫帑二萬馀。

translations.literal: While Yinpei was in Hunan, Changde prefect Xi'erda exposed Wuling magistrate Feng Qizhe's deficit in treasury funds of more than twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: While Yinpei was in Hunan, Changde prefect Xi'erda exposed a deficit of more than twenty thousand taels in the treasury funds of Wuling magistrate Feng Qizhe.

sentences.zh: 時因培報通省倉穀無虧，慮以歧誤得罪；

translations.literal: At the time Yinpei had reported that granary grain throughout the province showed no deficit; he feared being punished for the discrepancy;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yinpei had reported that granary grain throughout the province showed no deficit; he feared being punished for the discrepancy;

sentences.zh: 示意布政使赫升額，令桂陽知州張宏燧代其柘償萬馀，不足，仍疏劾。

translations.literal: he hinted to provincial administration commissioner Hesheng'e, had Guiyang prefect Zhang Hongsui repay more than ten thousand on Qizhe's behalf, and when this was insufficient still memorialized impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: he hinted to provincial administration commissioner Hesheng'e, had Guiyang prefect Zhang Hongsui repay more than ten thousand taels on Qizhe's behalf, and when this was insufficient still memorialized for impeachment.

sentences.zh: 會宏燧讞縣民侯岳添被殺，誤指罪人，為按察使宮兆麟所糾。

translations.literal: It happened that in Hongsui's assize of the murder of county resident Hou Yuetian he wrongly identified the culprit and was impeached by provincial surveillance commissioner Gong Zhaolin.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that in Hongsui's trial of the murder of county resident Hou Yuetian he wrongly identified the culprit and was impeached by provincial surveillance commissioner Gong Zhaolin.

sentences.zh: 因培及繼任巡撫常鈞覆讞不能決，上命侍郎期成額即訊，因得宏燧營私虧帑，及承因培指代其柘償金諸狀，以聞。

translations.literal: Yinpei and his successor Governor Chang Jun reinvestigated but could not decide; the emperor ordered Vice Minister Qicheng'e to interrogate at once; thereby Hongsui's private dealings and treasury deficits were established, as well as his following Yinpei's instruction to repay Qizhe's funds on his behalf, and this was reported.
translations.idiomatic: Yinpei and his successor Governor Chang Jun reinvestigated but could not reach a decision; the emperor ordered Vice Minister Qicheng'e to interrogate at once; thereby Hongsui's private dealings and treasury deficits were established, as well as his following Yinpei's instruction to repay Qizhe's funds on his behalf, and this was reported.

sentences.zh: 上命奪因培官，逮送湖北對簿，具服。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Yinpei stripped of office, arrested and sent to Hubei for trial, where he fully confessed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Yinpei stripped of office, arrested and sent to Hubei for trial, where he fully confessed.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「諸直省倉庫虧缺，最為錮弊。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Deficits in the granaries and treasuries of all provinces are the most entrenched abuse.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Deficits in the granaries and treasuries of all provinces are the most entrenched abuse.

sentences.zh: 昔皇考嚴加重戒，硃批諭旨，不啻三令五申，人亦不敢輕犯。

translations.literal: Formerly my late father imposed severe warnings, with vermilion-ink edicts repeated again and again, and people did not dare lightly violate them.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly my late father imposed severe warnings, with vermilion-ink edicts repeated again and again, and officials did not dare lightly violate them.

sentences.zh: 朕御極三十馀年，有犯必懲，乃近年營私骫法，屢有發覺。

translations.literal: I have reigned more than thirty years and punished every offense, yet in recent years private dealings and bending the law have repeatedly been discovered.
translations.idiomatic: I have reigned more than thirty years and punished every offense, yet in recent years private dealings and bending the law have repeatedly come to light.

sentences.zh: 豈因稽查稍疏，故態復作？

translations.literal: Is it because oversight has grown slightly lax that the old ways have revived?
translations.idiomatic: Is it because oversight has grown slightly lax that the old abuses have revived?

sentences.zh: 朕自愧誠不能感人，若再不能執法，則朕亦非甚懦弱姑息之主也。」

translations.literal: I myself regret that I truly cannot move people by sincerity; if I cannot enforce the law again, then I am not so weak and indulgent a sovereign either."
translations.idiomatic: I myself regret that I truly cannot move people by sincerity; if I cannot enforce the law again, then I am not so weak and indulgent a sovereign either."

sentences.zh: 期成額奏至，因培下刑部論斬決，上命改監候。

translations.literal: When Qicheng'e's report arrived, Yinpei was sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed execution; the emperor ordered it changed to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: When Qicheng'e's report arrived, Yinpei was sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed execution; the emperor ordered it changed to imprisonment awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 秋讞入情實，賜自盡。

translations.literal: At the autumn assize he was entered as a confirmed case and granted death by his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: At the autumn assize he was entered as a confirmed case and granted permission to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 常安，字履坦，納喇氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人。

translations.literal: Chang An, style name Lütan, of the Nara clan, was a bondsman of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An, style name Lütan, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 以諸生授筆帖式，自刑部改隸山西巡撫署。

translations.literal: As a licentiate he was appointed a clerk, transferred from the Ministry of Punishments to serve under the Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: As a licentiate he was appointed a clerk, then transferred from the Ministry of Punishments to serve under the governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，擢太原理事通判。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he was promoted to Taiyuan subprefect and judicial intendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yongzheng reign he was promoted to subprefect and judicial intendant of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 世宗時，庶僚皆得上章言事。

translations.literal: During the Shizong reign, all subordinate officials could submit memorials on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign, all subordinate officials could submit memorials on public affairs.

sentences.zh: 常安疏請裁驛站館夫及諸官署鐙夫，省科派，從之。

translations.literal: Chang An memorialized to cut post-station attendants and lamp-bearers at various government offices to reduce levies; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An memorialized to cut post-station attendants and lamp-bearers at various government offices to reduce levies; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 尋擢冀寧道。

translations.literal: Shortly after he was promoted to Jining circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was promoted to intendant of the Jining circuit.

sentences.zh: 遷廣西按察使，移雲南。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Guangxi provincial surveillance commissioner, then to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner of Guangxi, then to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 就遷布政使，移貴州。

translations.literal: He was then transferred to provincial administration commissioner and moved to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to provincial administration commissioner and transferred to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「苗疆多事，由於兵役擾累。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Troubles in the Miao frontier arise from harassment by soldiers and corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Troubles in the Miao frontier arise from harassment by soldiers and corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 嗣後有擾累事，罪該管文武官。」

translations.literal: Hereafter, whenever there is such harassment, the civil and military officials in charge shall be held guilty."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter, whenever there is such harassment, the civil and military officials in charge shall be held responsible."

sentences.zh: 下云貴廣西總督議行。

translations.literal: This was sent down to the Yun-Gui-Guangxi governor-general for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: This was sent to the governor-general of Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 遷江西巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以母喪去官。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he left office on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，還京師，舟經仲家淺，其僕迫閘官非時啟閘越渡，高宗聞之，諭謂：「皇考臨御時所未嘗有！

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, returning to the capital, his boat passed Zhongjia Ford; his servants forced the lock keeper to open the sluice out of season and cross; when the Gaozong heard of it, an edict said: "This never happened in my late father's reign!
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736), returning to the capital, his boat passed Zhongjia Ford; his servants forced the lock keeper to open the sluice out of season and cross; when the emperor heard of it, an edict declared: "This never happened in my late father's reign!

sentences.zh: 徒以初政崇尚寬大，常安封疆大吏，乃為此市井跋扈之舉，目無功令。」

translations.literal: Only because the early reign valued leniency, Chang An—a frontier grand official—has made this market-town bullying act, treating regulations with contempt.
translations.idiomatic: Only because the early reign valued leniency, Chang An—a frontier grand official—has committed this market-town bullying act, treating regulations with contempt.

sentences.zh: 下東河總督白鍾山按治，奪官，下刑部論罪，當枷號鞭責，命貸之，往北路軍營董糧餉。

translations.literal: Eastern Rivers Governor-General Bai Zhongshan was ordered to investigate; Chang An was stripped of office and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed cangue and whipping; he was pardoned and sent to manage grain supplies at the northern-route military camps.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Rivers Governor-General Bai Zhongshan was ordered to investigate; Chang An was stripped of office and sent to the Ministry of Punishments, which proposed the cangue and whipping; his punishment was remitted and he was sent to manage grain supplies at the northern-route military camps.

sentences.zh: 四年，授盛京兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed vice minister of War at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1739) he was appointed vice minister of War at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 內移刑部侍郎，外授漕運總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred within to vice minister of Punishments, then sent out as grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred within to vice minister of Punishments, then sent out as governor-general of grain transport.

sentences.zh: 內閣學士雅爾呼達請增遣滿洲兵駐防口外，直隸總督孫嘉淦疏請於獨石口、張家口外擇可耕地屯兵招墾。

translations.literal: Grand Secretariat academician Ya'erhuda requested additional dispatch of Manchu troops to garrison beyond the passes; Zhili Governor-General Sun Jiagan memorialized to select cultivable land beyond Dushikou and Zhangjiakou for garrison farming and recruitment of settlers.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretariat academician Ya'erhuda requested additional dispatch of Manchu troops to garrison beyond the passes; Zhili Governor-General Sun Jiagan memorialized to select cultivable land beyond Dushikou and Zhangjiakou for garrison farming and recruitment of settlers.

sentences.zh: 常安以為侵蒙古游牧地，疏請寢其事。

translations.literal: Chang An held that this would encroach on Mongol pasturelands and memorialized to abandon the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An held that this would encroach on Mongol pasturelands and memorialized to abandon the proposal.

sentences.zh: 六年，移浙江巡撫，謝上，因言：「屬吏賢否視上司為表率，惟有身先砥礪，共勵清操。」

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Zhejiang governor; in his audience of thanks he said: "Whether subordinates are worthy depends on their superiors as models; only by taking the lead in self-discipline can we jointly encourage integrity."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1741) he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang; in his audience of thanks he said: "Whether subordinates are worthy depends on their superiors as models; only by taking the lead in self-discipline can we jointly encourage integrity."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「廉固人臣之本，然封疆大臣非僅廉所能勝任。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Integrity is indeed the foundation of a minister, yet a frontier grand official cannot be equal to his post by integrity alone.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Integrity is indeed the foundation of a minister, yet a frontier grand official cannot fulfill his duties by integrity alone.

sentences.zh: 為國家計安全，為生民謀衣食，其事正多。

translations.literal: Planning security for the state and clothing and food for the people—there is much else to be done.
translations.idiomatic: Planning security for the state and clothing and food for the people—there is much else to be done.

sentences.zh: 觀汝有終身誦廉之意則非矣。」

translations.literal: To judge from your intent to chant integrity all your life—that is not it."
translations.idiomatic: From your talk of chanting integrity all your life—that is not what I mean."

sentences.zh: 上念浙江海塘為民保障，詔詢近時狀，並命閩浙總督那蘇圖、杭州將軍傅森會常安詳勘。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful that Zhejiang's seawalls were the people's safeguard, proclaimed an inquiry into recent conditions and ordered Zhe-Fujian Governor-General Nasutu, Hangzhou general Fusen, and Chang An jointly to investigate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, mindful that Zhejiang's seawalls were the people's safeguard, proclaimed an inquiry into recent conditions and ordered Zhe-Fujian Governor-General Nasutu, Hangzhou general Fusen, and Chang An jointly to investigate in detail.

sentences.zh: 常安等議：「海寧至仁和原有柴塘，塘外臨水，仿河工絡壩之法，用竹簍盛碎石，層層排築，外捍潮汐，內護塘基。

translations.literal: Chang An and the others deliberated: "From Haining to Renhe there were originally wattled seawalls; facing the water outside the wall, following the river-works method of linked dams, bamboo baskets filled with broken stone were laid in tiers to repel the tides outside and protect the wall foundation within.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An and the others reported: "From Haining to Renhe there were originally wattled seawalls; facing the water outside the wall, following the river-works method of linked dams, bamboo baskets filled with broken stone were laid in tiers to repel the tides outside and protect the wall foundation within.

sentences.zh: 水去沙停，漸有淤灘，再用左都御史劉統勳議，改建石塘。」

translations.literal: When the water receded the sand settled and silt banks gradually formed; following the proposal of Left Censor-in-Chief Liu Tongxun, stone seawalls were then built.
translations.idiomatic: When the water receded the sand settled and silt banks gradually formed; following the proposal of Left Censor-in-Chief Liu Tongxun, stone seawalls were then built.

sentences.zh: 別疏又言：「塘工可大可小，大則終年興工，亦難保其無虞；

translations.literal: A separate memorial also said: "Seawall works can be large or small; if large, construction runs all year and it is still hard to guarantee no mishap;
translations.idiomatic: A separate memorial also said: "Seawall works can be large or small; if large, construction runs all year and it is still hard to guarantee no mishap;

sentences.zh: 小則應興則興，應停則停，惟期免於衝決。

translations.literal: if small, work when it should begin and stop when it should stop, only hoping to avoid breach.
translations.idiomatic: if small, work when it should begin and stop when it should stop, only hoping to avoid breach.

sentences.zh: 是在因時損益，不宜惜費，亦不宜糜費。

translations.literal: The point is to adjust according to the times—one should neither be stingy with funds nor squander them.
translations.idiomatic: The point is to adjust according to the times—one should neither be stingy with funds nor squander them.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四五年間所修石塘，竭力督催，明歲可望全完。

translations.literal: The stone seawalls repaired in the forty-fourth and forty-fifth years of Qianlong are being urged on with all effort and may be fully completed next year.
translations.idiomatic: The stone seawalls repaired in the forty-fourth and forty-fifth years of Qianlong are being urged on with all effort and may be fully completed next year.

sentences.zh: 各塘不無闊狹高低，必須整齊堅固。

translations.literal: Each section of wall inevitably varies in width, height, and level and must be made uniform and solid.
translations.idiomatic: Each section of wall inevitably varies in width, height, and level and must be made uniform and solid.

sentences.zh: 臣諭督塘兵培補鑲墊，俾塘有堅工，兵無閒曠。

translations.literal: Your servant has instructed the seawall garrison troops to repair, patch, and reinforce so that the wall has solid work and the soldiers have no idle time.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has instructed the seawall garrison troops to repair, patch, and reinforce so that the wall has solid work and the soldiers have no idle time.

sentences.zh: 海寧塘后舊有土塘以備泛溢，令民間栽柳，根株盤結塘身，枝幹藉資工用。」

translations.literal: Behind the Haining wall there was formerly an earthen embankment against overflow; the people were ordered to plant willows whose roots would bind the wall body and whose branches could supply materials for the works.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the Haining wall there was formerly an earthen embankment against overflow; the people were ordered to plant willows whose roots would bind the wall body and whose branches could supply materials for the works.

sentences.zh: 八年，石工乃成。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the stone works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the stone works were completed.

sentences.zh: 常安在浙江久，有惠政：嘗用保甲法編太湖漁舟，清盜源；

translations.literal: Chang An served long in Zhejiang and had benevolent policies: he once used the baojia system to register fishing boats on Tai Lake and clear out the sources of banditry;
translations.idiomatic: Chang An served long in Zhejiang and had benevolent policies: he once used the baojia system to register fishing boats on Tai Lake and clear out the sources of banditry;

sentences.zh: 釐兩浙鹺政諸弊，蘇商困；

translations.literal: he rectified abuses in the salt administration of the two Zhe provinces, relieving distress among Suzhou merchants;
translations.idiomatic: he rectified abuses in the salt administration of the two Zhe provinces, relieving distress among Suzhou merchants;

sentences.zh: 以溫、處二府貧瘠鮮蓋藏，招商轉江蘇米自海道至，佐民食。

translations.literal: because Wenzhou and Chuzhou prefectures were poor and barren with little stored grain, he recruited merchants to transport Jiangsu rice by sea route to supplement the people's food supply.
translations.idiomatic: because Wenzhou and Chuzhou prefectures were poor and barren with little stored grain, he recruited merchants to transport Jiangsu rice by sea route to supplement the people's food supply.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫陳大受疏論常安輕開海禁，常安疏辨。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Chen Dashou memorialized that Chang An had lightly opened the maritime prohibition; Chang An memorialized in rebuttal.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu Governor Chen Dashou memorialized that Chang An had lightly opened the maritime prohibition; Chang An memorialized in rebuttal.

sentences.zh: 謂：「蘇視溫、處彼此雖殊，兩地皆皇上赤子，大受不當過分畛域。」

translations.literal: He said: "Jiangsu and Wen-Chu may differ from each other, yet both regions are the emperor's own children; Dashou should not draw boundaries too sharply."
translations.idiomatic: He said: "Jiangsu and Wen-Chu may differ from each other, yet both regions are the emperor's own children; Dashou should not draw boundaries too sharply."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「汝等以此而矛盾，皆為民耳，出於不得已。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "You are at odds over this, yet all for the people's sake, out of necessity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "You are at odds over this, yet all for the people's sake, out of necessity.

sentences.zh: 以後豐年可不須，若需穀孔亟，當視此行耳。」

translations.literal: In future years of plenty it may not be needed; if grain is urgently required, regard this route."
translations.idiomatic: In future years of plenty it may not be needed; if grain is urgently required, regard this route."

sentences.zh: 常安巡視寧波沿海諸地，泛海至鎮海，又至定海，疏陳內外洋諸島嶼狀，謂內洋宜招民廣墾，外洋宜封禁。

translations.literal: Chang An inspected the coastal regions around Ningbo, crossed the sea to Zhenhai and then to Dinghai, memorialized on the condition of islands in the inner and outer seas, and held that the inner sea should recruit settlers for broad reclamation while the outer sea should be sealed off.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An inspected the coastal regions around Ningbo, crossed the sea to Zhenhai and then to Dinghai, memorialized on the condition of islands in the inner and outer seas, and held that the inner sea should recruit settlers for broad reclamation while the outer sea should be sealed off.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其衝冒風濤，勤於王事。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him for braving wind and waves and diligently serving the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him for braving wind and waves and diligently serving the throne.

sentences.zh: 嘉、湖二府奸民迷誘民間子女，常安督吏捕治，悉獲諸奸民。

translations.literal: In Jiaxing and Huzhou prefectures wicked men enticed and abducted common people's children; Chang An supervised officials in arresting them and captured all the culprits.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaxing and Huzhou prefectures wicked men enticed and abducted common people's children; Chang An supervised officials in arresting them and captured all the culprits.

sentences.zh: 上令視採生折割例從重定擬，飭常安寬縱。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered sentencing according to the precedent for abducting living persons for mutilation, with heavier penalties, and reproached Chang An for leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered sentencing according to the precedent for abducting living persons for mutilation, with heavier penalties, and rebuked Chang An for leniency.

sentences.zh: 尋上疏言：「州縣親民吏，必於轄境事無繁簡、地無遠近莫不深知，而後有實政以及於民。
