translations.literal: Shortly after he memorialized: "Prefectural and county officials who are close to the people must thoroughly know every matter in their jurisdiction, whether complex or simple, near or far, before they can have real policies that reach the people.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after he memorialized: "Prefectural and county officials who are close to the people must thoroughly know every matter in their jurisdiction, whether complex or simple, near or far, before they can have real policies that reach the people.

sentences.zh: 應飭於齋戒停刑暇日親歷鄉村，以次而遍。

translations.literal: They should be ordered on days of fasting and suspension of executions, in their spare time, to visit villages in person, passing through them in turn.
translations.idiomatic: They should be ordered on days of fasting and suspension of executions, in their spare time, to visit villages in person, passing through them in turn.

sentences.zh: 引其父老，詢以疾苦，於地方利弊了然胸中，且籍以周知戶口。

translations.literal: They should summon village elders and inquire about hardships, so that local advantages and harms are clear in their minds and household registers are thereby fully known.
translations.idiomatic: They should summon village elders and inquire about hardships, so that local advantages and harms are clear in their minds and household registers are thereby fully known.

sentences.zh: 如遇災賑，董理易為力。」

translations.literal: If disaster relief is needed, supervision will be easier to accomplish."
translations.idiomatic: If disaster relief is needed, supervision will be easier to accomplish."

sentences.zh: 上深然之。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply approved of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply approved of this.

sentences.zh: 錢塘江入海處近蕭山為南大亹，近海寧為北大亹，蜀山南別有中小亹。

translations.literal: Where the Qiantang River enters the sea, near Xiaoshan is the southern great estuary channel, near Haining the northern great estuary channel, and south of Shushan there is separately a middle and small estuary channel.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Qiantang River enters the sea, near Xiaoshan is the southern great estuary channel, near Haining the northern great estuary channel, and south of Shushan there is separately a middle and small estuary channel.

sentences.zh: 舊為江海匯流處，漸淤塞，水趨南大亹，逼海寧。

translations.literal: Formerly the confluence of river and sea, it gradually silted up and the water turned toward the southern great channel, pressing upon Haining.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the confluence of river and sea, it gradually silted up and the water turned toward the southern great channel, pressing upon Haining.

sentences.zh: 九年，尚書訥親蒞視，議復中小亹故道。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Minister Neqin came to inspect and proposed restoring the old course of the middle and small estuary channels.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Minister Neqin came to inspect and proposed restoring the old course of the middle and small estuary channels.

sentences.zh: 常安令就沙嘴為溝四，引潮刷沙，歷數年，沙漸去。

translations.literal: Chang An ordered four channels cut at the sand spit to draw in the tide and scour away sand; over several years the sand gradually departed.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An ordered four channels cut at the sand spit to draw in the tide and scour away sand; over several years the sand gradually departed.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏言：「春伏兩汛已過，南沙坍卸殆盡，蜀山已在水中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "The spring and summer flood tides have passed; the southern sand bank has collapsed and washed away almost entirely, and Shushan is already in the water.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he memorialized: "The spring and summer flood tides have passed; the southern sand bank has collapsed and washed away almost entirely, and Shushan is already in the water.

sentences.zh: 倘秋汛不復湧沙，大溜竟行中小亹矣。」

translations.literal: If the autumn tide does not again bring surging sand, the main current will entirely run through the middle and small channels."
translations.idiomatic: If the autumn tide does not again bring surging sand, the main current will entirely run through the middle and small channels."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此言豈可輕出？

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "How can such words be lightly spoken?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "How can such words be lightly spoken?

sentences.zh: 亦俟三五年後如何耳。

translations.literal: We must wait three or five years to see how things turn out.
translations.idiomatic: We must wait three or five years to see how things turn out.

sentences.zh: 如能全行中小亹，果可喜事也。」

translations.literal: If the current can fully run through the middle and small channels, that would truly be cause for rejoicing."
translations.idiomatic: If the current can fully run through the middle and small channels, that would truly be cause for rejoicing."

sentences.zh: 十二年，閩浙總督喀爾吉善劾常安多得屬吏金，婪索及於鹽政承差、海關胥吏，縱僕取市肆珍貴物不予值，凡十數事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Zhe-Fujian Governor-General Ka'erjishan impeached Chang An for receiving much silver from subordinates, extorting even salt administration agents and customs clerks, and allowing servants to take precious goods from shops without payment—in more than a dozen matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Zhe-Fujian Governor-General Ka'erjishan impeached Chang An for receiving much silver from subordinates, extorting even salt administration agents and customs clerks, and allowing servants to take precious goods from shops without payment—in more than a dozen matters.

sentences.zh: 上命解任，以顧琮代之，令大學士高斌會顧琮按治。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him relieved of office, replaced by Gu Cong, and ordered Grand Secretary Gaobin to join Gu Cong in investigating.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him relieved of office, replaced by Gu Cong, and ordered Grand Secretary Gaobin to join Gu Cong in investigating.

sentences.zh: 常安亦疏劾布政使唐綏祖徇私狂悖，上為下高斌等並按。

translations.literal: Chang An also memorialized impeaching provincial administration commissioner Tang Suizu for favoritism and insolence; the emperor sent this down to Gaobin and the others for joint investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An also memorialized impeaching provincial administration commissioner Tang Suizu for favoritism and insolence; the emperor sent this down to Gaobin and the others for joint investigation.

sentences.zh: 高斌等按常安婪贓納賄狀皆不實，惟縱僕得賕；

translations.literal: Gaobin and the others investigated and found the charges of Chang An's greed for bribes and acceptance of gifts all unsubstantiated, save that his servants had taken bribes;
translations.idiomatic: Gaobin and the others investigated and found the charges of Chang An's greed for bribes and acceptance of gifts all unsubstantiated, save that his servants had taken bribes;

sentences.zh: 常安劾綏祖事盡虛，疏請奪常安官。

translations.literal: Chang An's impeachment of Suizu was entirely false; they memorialized requesting Chang An be stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An's impeachment of Suizu was entirely false; they memorialized requesting Chang An be stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 上命大學士訥親覆按，未至，高斌等又言常安歲易鹽政承差，有婪索狀；

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Grand Secretary Neqin to reinvestigate; before he arrived, Gaobin and the others again reported that Chang An changed salt administration agents yearly and there were signs of extortion;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Grand Secretary Neqin to reinvestigate; before he arrived, Gaobin and the others again reported that Chang An changed salt administration agents yearly and there were signs of extortion;

sentences.zh: 訥親至，又言常安嘗以公使錢自私，按律擬絞，下刑部，卒於獄。

translations.literal: when Neqin arrived he again reported that Chang An had once used public funds for private ends; according to law strangulation was proposed; he was sent to the Ministry of Punishments and died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: when Neqin arrived he again reported that Chang An had once used public funds for private ends; according to law strangulation was proposed; he was sent to the Ministry of Punishments and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 常安少受業於尚書韓菼，工文辭，有所論著，多譏切時事。

translations.literal: Chang An in youth studied under Minister Han Tan, was skilled in literary composition, and in his writings often satirized current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An in youth studied under Minister Han Tan, was skilled in literary composition, and in his writings often satirized current affairs.

sentences.zh: 其坐譴多舉細故，遽從重比。

translations.literal: His punishments mostly cited petty matters yet were suddenly matched to heavy penalties.
translations.idiomatic: His punishments mostly cited petty matters yet were suddenly matched to heavy penalties.

sentences.zh: 時論疑其中蜚語以死，非其罪也。

translations.literal: Contemporary opinion suspected that slander within brought about his death and that it was not his true crime.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporary opinion suspected that slander within brought about his death and that it was not his true crime.

sentences.zh: 福崧，烏雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人，湖廣總督碩色孫也。

translations.literal: Fu Song, of the Uya clan, was a bondsman of the Plain Yellow Banner and a grandson of Huguang Governor-General Shuose.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Song, of the Uya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a grandson of Huguang Governor-General Shuose.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，授內閣中書，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign he was appointed a Grand Secretariat drafter and promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign he was appointed a Grand Secretariat drafter and promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 外授四川川北道，遷甘肅按察使。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Sichuan Chuanbei circuit intendant and transferred to Gansu provincial surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as intendant of the Chuanbei circuit in Sichuan and transferred to provincial surveillance commissioner of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 再遷福建布政使，未行，蘇四十三亂作，從總督勒爾謹討賊，即移甘肅。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Fujian provincial administration commissioner; before departing, Su Forty-three's rebellion broke out; he followed Governor-General Le'erjin to suppress the rebels and was immediately transferred to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to provincial administration commissioner of Fujian; before departing, Su Forty-three's rebellion broke out; he followed Governor-General Le'erjin to suppress the rebels and was immediately transferred to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 事定，賜花翎。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled he was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 勒爾謹坐冒賑得罪，命福崧從總督李侍堯察通省倉庫，虧銀八十八萬、糧七十四萬有奇，立例清償，無力者以責上官。

translations.literal: Le'erjin was punished for false disaster relief; Fu Song was ordered to follow Governor-General Li Shiyao in inspecting granaries and treasuries throughout the province, finding deficits of 880,000 taels of silver and more than 740,000 piculs of grain; precedents were established for repayment, and those unable to pay were charged to their superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Le'erjin was punished for false disaster relief; Fu Song was ordered to follow Governor-General Li Shiyao in inspecting granaries and treasuries throughout the province, finding deficits of 880,000 taels of silver and more than 740,000 piculs of grain; precedents were established for repayment, and those unable to pay were charged to their superiors.

sentences.zh: 福崧亦應分償，上特免之。

translations.literal: Fu Song was also liable to share repayment; the emperor specially exempted him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Song was also liable to share repayment; the emperor specially exempted him.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，遷浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上以王亶望、陳輝祖相繼撫浙江，皆貪吏，復命察通省倉庫，虧銀一百三十萬有奇，立例清償如甘肅。

translations.literal: Because Wang Tanwang and Chen Huizu had successively governed Zhejiang as corrupt officials, he was again ordered to inspect granaries and treasuries throughout the province, finding deficits of more than 1,300,000 taels of silver; precedents for repayment were established as in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Because Wang Tanwang and Chen Huizu had successively governed Zhejiang as corrupt officials, he was again ordered to inspect granaries and treasuries throughout the province, finding deficits of more than 1,300,000 taels of silver; precedents for repayment were established as in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 桐鄉縣徵漕不如律，民聚閧，福崧令捕治，因疏陳嚴除漕弊，條四事，下部議行。

translations.literal: In Tongxiang County grain transport collection did not follow regulations and the people gathered in riot; Fu Song ordered arrests and memorialized on strictly eliminating abuses in transport collection, listing four items, which were sent to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongxiang County grain transport collection did not follow regulations and the people gathered in riot; Fu Song ordered arrests and memorialized on strictly eliminating abuses in transport collection, listing four items, which were sent to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，上南巡，兩浙鹽商輸銀六十萬，以海寧范公塘改柴為石，福崧為請，上允之。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, on the emperor's southern tour, the salt merchants of the two Zhe provinces contributed 600,000 taels of silver to convert the Fan Gong embankment at Haining from wattled to stone construction; Fu Song requested this and the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year, on the emperor's southern tour, the salt merchants of the two Zhe provinces contributed 600,000 taels of silver to convert the Fan Gong embankment at Haining from wattled to stone construction; Fu Song requested this and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，福崧以諸屬吏清償倉庫虧銀未能如期，疏請展限；

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, because subordinate officials could not repay treasury deficits on schedule, Fu Song memorialized requesting an extension;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year, because subordinate officials could not repay treasury deficits on schedule, Fu Song memorialized requesting an extension;

sentences.zh: 並言於正歲集司道以下等官設誓，共砥廉隅。

translations.literal: he also proposed that at the New Year circuit intendants and officials below should assemble to swear oaths jointly to sharpen their integrity.
translations.idiomatic: he also proposed that at the New Year circuit intendants and officials below should assemble to swear oaths jointly to sharpen their integrity.

sentences.zh: 上以期已三四年，乃復請展限，非是，且設誓亦非政體，命尚書曹文埴，侍郎姜晟、伊齡阿如浙江按治。

translations.literal: The emperor held that the deadline had already been three or four years and to request extension again was wrong; moreover oath-taking was not proper governance; he ordered Ministers Cao Wenchi, Vice Ministers Jiang Sheng, and Yiling'a to go to Zhejiang to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that the deadline had already been three or four years and to request extension again was wrong; moreover oath-taking was not proper governance; he ordered Ministers Cao Wenchi, Vice Ministers Jiang Sheng, and Yiling'a to go to Zhejiang to investigate.

sentences.zh: 會福崧請籌柴塘修費，上疑新建石塘無益，勞民傷財，令文埴等並按，召福崧還京師待命。

translations.literal: It happened that Fu Song requested funds for repairing wattled seawalls; the emperor suspected the newly built stone seawalls were useless, laboring the people and wasting resources; he ordered Wenchi and the others to investigate jointly and summoned Fu Song back to the capital to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Fu Song requested funds for repairing wattled seawalls; the emperor suspected the newly built stone seawalls were useless, laboring the people and wasting resources; he ordered Wenchi and the others to investigate jointly and summoned Fu Song back to the capital to await orders.

sentences.zh: 文埴等疏陳浙江倉庫實虧數，為定善後章程；

translations.literal: Wenchi and the others memorialized the actual deficit figures in Zhejiang's granaries and treasuries and established follow-up regulations;
translations.idiomatic: Wenchi and the others memorialized the actual deficit figures in Zhejiang's granaries and treasuries and established follow-up regulations;

sentences.zh: 別疏言柴塘坦水為石塘保障，宜有歲修。

translations.literal: a separate memorial said that the wattled seawalls and sloping aprons were safeguards for the stone seawalls and should receive annual repairs.
translations.idiomatic: a separate memorial said that the wattled seawalls and sloping aprons were safeguards for the stone seawalls and should receive annual repairs.

sentences.zh: 上允其請，察福崧無敗檢事，失但在柔懦，命署山西巡撫。

translations.literal: The emperor approved the request, found Fu Song had no scandalous conduct, his fault lying only in weakness, and ordered him to serve as acting Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the request, found Fu Song had no scandalous conduct, his fault lying only in weakness, and ordered him to serve as acting governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 旋以浙江學政竇光鼐劾平陽知縣黃梅貪黷，論如律，責福崧未能發，左授二等侍衛，充和闐幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly after, Zhejiang educational commissioner Dou Guangnai impeached Huang Mei, magistrate of Pingyang, for greed and corruption; he was sentenced according to law; Fu Song was reproached for failing to expose it and was demoted to second-rank guard and appointed assistant commissioner for Khotan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after, Zhejiang educational commissioner Dou Guangnai impeached Huang Mei, magistrate of Pingyang, for greed and corruption; he was sentenced according to law; Fu Song was rebuked for failing to expose it and was demoted to second-rank guard and appointed assistant commissioner for Khotan affairs.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，移阿克蘇辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to commissioner for Aksu affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year he was transferred to commissioner for Aksu affairs.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，再移葉爾羌參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year he was again transferred to participating commissioner at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was again transferred to participating commissioner at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，授江蘇巡撫，署兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was appointed Jiangsu governor and served as acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year he was appointed governor of Jiangsu and served as acting governor-general of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 還授浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，疏請補修海塘石工，與前巡撫琅玕改築柴壩異議，上命江蘇巡撫長麟往按，請如福崧議。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he memorialized requesting repairs to the stone seawall works, differing from former governor Langgan's proposal to rebuild wattled dams; the emperor ordered Jiangsu Governor Chang Lin to investigate and approved Fu Song's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he memorialized requesting repairs to the stone seawall works, differing from former governor Langgan's proposal to rebuild wattled dams; the emperor ordered Jiangsu Governor Chang Lin to investigate and approved Fu Song's proposal.

sentences.zh: 浙江鹽道柴槙遷兩淮鹽運使，虧帑，私移兩淮鹽課二十二萬補之。

translations.literal: Zhejiang salt intendant Chai Zhen was transferred to Liang-Huai salt transport commissioner; he had a treasury deficit and privately diverted 220,000 taels of Liang-Huai salt revenue to cover it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang salt intendant Chai Zhen was transferred to Liang-Huai salt transport commissioner; he had a treasury deficit and privately diverted 220,000 taels of Liang-Huai salt revenue to cover it.

sentences.zh: 兩淮鹽政全德疏劾，上以福崧領兩浙鹽政，慮有染，奪官，以長麟代之。

translations.literal: Liang-Huai salt commissioner Quande memorialized impeachment; because Fu Song oversaw the salt administration of the two Zhe provinces, the emperor feared contamination, stripped him of office, and replaced him with Chang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Liang-Huai salt commissioner Quande memorialized for impeachment; because Fu Song oversaw the salt administration of the two Zhe provinces, the emperor feared he was implicated, stripped him of office, and replaced him with Chang Lin.

sentences.zh: 命尚書慶桂會鞫，謂福崧嘗索槙賕十一萬，又侵公使錢六萬有奇。

translations.literal: Minister Qinggui was ordered to join in the interrogation; it was held that Fu Song had once extorted 110,000 taels in bribes from Zhen and had also embezzled more than 60,000 taels of public funds.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Qinggui was ordered to join in the interrogation; it was held that Fu Song had once extorted 110,000 taels in bribes from Zhen and had also embezzled more than 60,000 taels of public funds.

sentences.zh: 獄具，論斬，逮致京師，尋命即途中行法。

translations.literal: When the case was concluded execution was proposed; he was arrested and sent to the capital, then ordered to be executed en route.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was concluded execution was proposed; he was arrested and sent to the capital, then ordered to be executed en route.

sentences.zh: 福崧飲酖卒。

translations.literal: Fu Song drank poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Song drank poison and died.

sentences.zh: 福崧為巡撫，治事明決，禦屬吏有法度，民頌其治行。

translations.literal: As governor, Fu Song managed affairs with clarity and decisiveness, controlled subordinates with discipline, and the people praised his governance.
translations.idiomatic: As governor, Fu Song managed affairs with clarity and decisiveness, controlled subordinates with discipline, and the people praised his governance.

sentences.zh: 其得罪死，頗謂其忤和珅，為所陷。

translations.literal: His conviction and death were widely said to stem from offending Heshen and being framed by him.
translations.idiomatic: His conviction and death were widely said to stem from offending Heshen and being framed by him.

sentences.zh: 尤慮至京師廷鞫，或發其陰私，故以蜚語激上怒，迫之死雲。

translations.literal: It was especially feared that if brought to the capital for court trial he might expose Heshen's private wrongdoing; therefore slander was used to inflame the emperor's anger and force him to death.
translations.idiomatic: It was especially feared that if brought to the capital for court trial he might expose Heshen's private wrongdoing; therefore slander was used to inflame the emperor's anger and force him to death.

sentences.zh: 論曰：居喪不沐浴，百日薙發，亦其遺意也。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Not bathing during mourning and shaving the head after the hundred-day period were also vestiges of that intent.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Not bathing during mourning and shaving the head after the hundred-day period were also vestiges of that intent.

sentences.zh: 塞楞額坐是中危法，學健雖以他事誅，然得罪仍在初獄。

translations.literal: Sai Leng'e was condemned on this account to the death penalty; Xuejian was executed on other charges, yet his offense still lay in the original case.
translations.idiomatic: Sai Leng'e was condemned on this account to the death penalty; Xuejian was executed on other charges, yet his offense still lay in the original case.

sentences.zh: 鄂昌以門戶生恩怨，家屏以搢紳言利病，皆足以掇禍。

translations.literal: E Chang through factional patronage incurred enmity; Jiaping through gentry talk of public harms and benefits—both were enough to draw disaster.
translations.idiomatic: E Chang through factional patronage incurred enmity; Jiaping through gentry talk of public harms and benefits—both were enough to draw disaster.

sentences.zh: 羅織文字，其借焉者也。

translations.literal: Fabricated charges from written words were the pretexts employed.
translations.idiomatic: Fabricated charges from written words were the pretexts employed.

sentences.zh: 因培起邊遠，受峻擢，屢躓屢起，乃以欺罔傅重比。

translations.literal: Yinpei rose from a remote region, received steep promotion, stumbled and rose again repeatedly, yet was finally matched to heavy penalties for deception.
translations.idiomatic: Yinpei rose from a remote region, received steep promotion, stumbled and rose again repeatedly, yet was finally matched to heavy penalties for deception.

sentences.zh: 常安、福崧死於賕，然封疆有政聲。

translations.literal: Chang An and Fu Song died over bribes, yet as frontier officials they had reputations for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Chang An and Fu Song died over bribes, yet as frontier officials they had reputations for good governance.

sentences.zh: 論者以為冤，事或然歟？

translations.literal: Commentators held them wronged—perhaps that was so?
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held them wronged—perhaps that was so?
